name: Little Nest
evidence: Little Nest Cafe serves honest breakfasts and lunches to parents tired of lame-o kid meals and half-effort adult dishes. Fresh West Coast fare, super-cool décor and a kids’ play area filled with retro toys.

name: PlayScape Café
evidence: Designed for little ones 5 and younger and their families, café with a by-admission indoor play.

name: Sushi Aboard
evidence: Order from a screen, and a mini train zooms your sushi to the table.

name: Earnest Ice Cream
evidence: it's a local favorite and I absolutely love their unique flavors!

name: Vancouver Public Library
evidence: The family-friendly suburb of Vancouver, Washington, offers many places for kids to dine or grab a quick bite with their adult chaperones between trips to Urban Air Adventure Park, Vancouver Public Library’s excellent kids play and read area, Fort Vancouver, or Dizzy Castle.

name: Kids Club Fun & Fitness
evidence: You can’t help but have fun in the Northwest’s largest indoor Jungle! There are 6 slides, a giant ballroom, a suspension bridge, roller tubes, ball swings, an interactive light space floor, Ballocity tower and more all under one roof!
hours_note: We are closed on statutory holidays. (from what you pasted, unconfirmed)

name: 365 Fundays
address: 365 Fundays, 3810, Jacombs Road, East Cambie, Richmond, Metro Vancouver Regional District, British Columbia, V6V 1Y6, Canada
evidence: Huge indoor play gym. Price is reasonable, the place is well maintained and cleaned regularly.

name: Maplewood Farm
address: Maplewood Farm, Maplewood, District of North Vancouver, Metro Vancouver Regional District, British Columbia, Canada
evidence: Maplewood Farm is a 5 acre (2 hectare) farm in North Vancouver, about 10 minutes from downtown.
